findings.reason: I confirmed the only declaration is `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel)` at UsernamePasswordForm.java:160, and grep finds no zero-argument overload, so the call at UsernameForm.java:47 does not compile and the services module build breaks.

The predicate at line 161 requires `user != null`, so `fillContextForm` is no longer called on the first login, where no user is set (lines 115 and 137); passkeys/conditional UI therefore disappear from the normal login page, which the PR's own tests expect to show `//form[@id='webauth']`.

The test does set passkeys to FALSE for the whole realm (its header comment says so), so the case of passkeys enabled with a password-only user re-authenticating is untested; this is a real but minor test gap, and the assertThrows suggestion is style.
